description: Key facts a correct lesson on each Power Electronics topic must state. Every fact was taken from the fetched text of the source page named with it (the quote is checked by `npm run golden:check`). Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions matched against the lesson text after LaTeX backslashes and braces are removed.
subject: power-electronics

facts.claim: Power electronics controls and converts electric power

source.quote: Power electronics is the application of electronics to the control and conversion of electric power

facts.claim: Devices work as switches, so little power is lost

source.quote: most power electronic applications rely on switching devices on and off, which makes systems very efficient

facts.claim: Power MOSFETs switch fast and are efficient at low voltages

source.quote: its main advantages are high switching speed and good efficiency at low voltages

facts.claim: A snubber suppresses voltage transients when inductive current is switched off

source.quote: Snubbers are frequently used in electrical systems with an inductive load where the sudden interruption of current flow leads to a large counter-electromotive force

facts.claim: A buck converter steps voltage down

source.quote: A buck converter or step-down converter is a DC-to-DC converter which decreases voltage

facts.claim: Vout = D × Vin (duty cycle)

source.quote: the output voltage of the converter varies linearly with the duty cycle

facts.claim: A boost converter steps voltage up

source.quote: In a boost converter, the output voltage is always higher than the input voltage

facts.claim: A flyback is a buck–boost converter with the inductor split into a transformer

source.quote: The flyback converter is a buck–boost converter with the inductor split to form a transformer

facts.claim: It gives galvanic isolation

source.quote: with galvanic isolation between the input and any outputs

facts.claim: An H-bridge has four switches

source.quote: An H-bridge is built with four switches

facts.claim: It reverses the polarity, so a DC motor can run both ways

source.quote: allow DC motors to run forwards or backwards

facts.claim: A rectifier converts AC to DC

source.quote: A rectifier is an electrical device that converts alternating current (AC), which periodically reverses direction, to direct current (DC)

facts.claim: THD compares harmonic content with the fundamental

source.quote: The total harmonic distortion (THD or THDi) is a measurement of the harmonic distortion present in a signal

facts.claim: Defined relative to the fundamental component

source.quote: is the RMS value of the fundamental component

facts.claim: An inverter converts DC to AC

source.quote: is a power electronic device or circuitry that changes direct current (DC) to alternating current (AC)

facts.claim: The inverter produces no power; the DC source supplies it

source.quote: The inverter does not produce any power; the power is provided by the DC source

facts.claim: PWM varies the duty cycle of a rectangular wave

source.quote: is any method of representing a signal as a rectangular wave with a varying duty cycle

facts.claim: Fast switching controls the average voltage or power

source.quote: PWM is useful for controlling the average power or amplitude delivered by an electrical signal

facts.claim: A TRIAC conducts in either direction once triggered

source.quote: a three-terminal electronic component that conducts current in either direction when triggered

facts.claim: Once triggered it conducts until current drops below the holding current

source.quote: continue to conduct, even if the gate current ceases, until the main current drops below a certain level called the holding current

facts.claim: A cycloconverter changes AC at one frequency into AC at a lower frequency directly

source.quote: converts a constant-amplitude, constant-frequency AC waveform to another AC waveform of a lower frequency
